# JPlayer

Source: https://github.com/devgamer383/jplayer
Pinned commit: f258e127fc5caf14f2ad7327886412c334223cc5
Distribution version: 3.8.5 (Plyr global API)

The JavaScript, CSS, and SVG are copied unchanged from dist/. LICENSE.md contains the upstream MIT license. All runtime assets are served locally. The watch page attaches its native media source after player construction to bypass the incomplete upstream automatic MKV demuxer.
